Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the treatment of eosinophilic gastrointestinal associated disorders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the treatment of eosinophilic gastrointestinalassociated disorders; and adding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each health benefit plan issued or renewed after December 31,2015, must offer benefits or coverage for medically necessary elementalformula, regardless of delivery method, when a licensed physician orother health care provider with prescriptive authority: (a) Diagnoses a patient with an eosinophilic gastrointestinalassociated disorder; and (b) Orders and supervises the use of the elemental formula. (2) The costsharing for medically necessary elemental formula mustbe included in the expenses that count toward the enrollee's annualout-of-pocket maximum, unless prohibited by the federal patientprotection and affordable care act, P.L. 111148, as amended by thefederal health care and education reconciliation act of 2010, P.L. 111152, or federal regulations or guidance issued under the affordablecare act. p. 1 SB 6073 (3) Nothing in this section prohibits a health benefit plan fromrequiring prior authorization or imposing other appropriate utilizationcontrols in approving coverage for medically necessary elementalformula.
